# salarioliquido.pt

## About
Portuguese salary calculator (Calculadora de Salário Líquido) for 2026.
Calculates net salary from gross, including IRS (income tax), TSU (social security),
subsidies (Christmas and holiday allowances), and deductions.

## Pages
- / — Main salary calculator with detailed breakdown and educational content
- /faq/ — Frequently asked questions about salary, IRS, TSU in Portugal
- /legal/ — Legal notices and terms of use
- /privacidade/ — Privacy policy (GDPR compliant)

## Key Data (2026)
- IRS brackets: 9 progressive brackets from 13.25% to 48%
- TSU: Employee 11%, Employer 23.75%
- Minimum wage: €870/month
- Specific deduction: €4,104
- Family deduction: €250/person
- 14 monthly salaries (12 + Christmas bonus + Holiday bonus)
- IRS Jovem: Reduced rates for first 5 working years (ages up to 35)

## Technology
- Built with Astro, React, Tailwind CSS
- All calculations performed client-side (no data sent to servers)
- Language: Portuguese (pt-PT)
